QUALIFIER_QUOTE: The 2023 agreement gave Northgate a $9.4 million property-tax abatement over ten years in exchange for creating 800 full-time jobs at the Ridgeline Parkway site by 2026, with a $3.1 million clawback if that commitment was missed. In March 2026, the Board amended the agreement to count "positions posted or filled, full or part time" toward the jobs commitment, rather than full-time jobs only. County economic-development staff had recommended against this change. Under the amended terms, Northgate's 310 positions meet the commitment, so the company is currently in compliance and the clawback has not been triggered.
